attempts.prompt:
Source-specific feature priority: CLEAN-SHAVEN: smooth yellow upper lip and chin; no moustache, beard, goatee or chin tuft. Skin shadows are not hair.

Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.
Image 1 is the original HOI4 portrait and composition target. Image 2 is the user's exact 奶龙 identity reference: a smooth golden-yellow round creature with green rings around black eyes, a small horizontal mouth and creamy belly.
Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. RETAIN the original person's visible hairstyle, hairline, hair color and eyebrows as distinguishing features attached to the mascot, adapting them to its round head. Match the original's parting, thickness and curls. Facial hair is conditional, never a default: copy moustache, beard or sideburns only when actually visible in this source, with its exact extent and color. Otherwise keep the upper lip and chin smooth yellow. Dark skin shading, nose shadows and lip creases are not facial hair. Preserve a bald scalp where the source has one and do not invent hair hidden under a hat.
Preserve the original garment design, uniform type, fabric, colors, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. RETAILOR the collar/neck opening and shoulder fit to the mascot rather than copying a narrow human neck opening. Keep all existing garment design details and insignia; do not invent new hats, uniforms, medals or symbols. Use only visually present features; do not infer appearance from filenames or historical biographies.
Keep the yellow creature's anatomy, large green-ringed black eyes and small horizontal mouth; do not restore human skin, human nose or human ears. Express the original mood through its creature eyes and mouth plus retained eyebrows.
Facial-hair placement: wherever the original has a moustache and chin beard, their top-to-bottom order is eyes, UPPER-LIP moustache, small horizontal mouth, chin beard. Never place the visible mouth above the moustache or turn the moustache into a second beard. Clean-shaven originals stay clean-shaven.
When the source actually has a moustache, show it as a distinct visible band of hair with fine painted hair texture ABOVE the mascot's existing grey lip and small mouth. The reference mascot's normal grey lip wedge or its shadow does not count as facial hair; do not merely recolor that lip and omit the moustache. Retain a narrow readable separation between the hair and mouth. Apply this only to genuinely visible source facial hair; clean-shaven sources retain the normal bare mascot mouth.
Retain the visible shape, symbol count and arrangement of source collar patches and existing decorations. Do not invent chest medallions. Any source note markings that are illegible remain indistinct texture; do not invent readable serial numbers, identification codes, words or labels.
Collar and anatomy: use a compact rounded mascot head seated close to broad shoulders, with a very short, wide neck transition. No tall cylindrical/giraffe neck, no long tapered yellow stalk above the clothing. The entire neck base must fit INSIDE a correctly sized collar opening. Widen and reshape the collar opening naturally around that base while keeping the original collar style, tabs, piping and badges. Collar front sits visibly in front of the lower neck; collar back sits behind it, with coherent perspective, contact shadow and fabric tension. No neck clipping through collar, pinched narrow ring, floating collar, broken seam or abrupt geometric junction. The creamy belly stays under opaque clothing; never add a cream/white bib on the neck. Respect this fit even for tiny advisor or pilot portraits.
The head silhouette is nearly round or a SHORT egg shape. Its chin rests immediately above the garment collar, without copying the original human neck length. Preserve the shoulder position and crop by broadening the fitted garment; do not fill that space with a tall yellow column.
The garment meets the underside of a visibly rounded chin. There is no separate exposed vertical neck column between the head and collar, including bald and three-quarter-view portraits.
The lower head silhouette curves inward toward its base instead of continuing down as parallel straight yellow sides. Raise and broaden the original collar and shoulders to meet that curved chin; do not insert an extra yellow neck roll underneath it.
Keep the source's fastening state: a buttoned closed standing collar remains closed and buttoned, with both front ends meeting naturally at the center seam. Do not turn a closed military collar into a deep V-neck or unbuttoned shirt. Preserve open lapels/shirt collars only where the original is actually open.
Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop and number of figures. Preserve real alpha transparency, photographic frames, note cards and existing decorative markings where present. Do not add such framing where absent. Polished painterly HOI4 finish, legible at the original in-game size. One source image to one asset. No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Visible features inspected from this exact source: Large standalone character portrait: preserve original background and crop; no photograph frame, cream note or decorative card. Clean-shaven; short closely cropped grey hair, olive military coat with open lapels, blue collar patches with small pale eagle insignia, gold shoulder boards, pale shirt and blue necktie. Preserve exact small chest ribbons and hanging medal, no invented facial hair. Retain the source exact open/closed outfit layering and fastening, head angle and gaze, with a near-round yellow mascot head resting directly inside a widened tailored collar. No long yellow neck, cream neck bib or floating collar.
Final source-specific check: CLEAN-SHAVEN: smooth yellow upper lip and chin; no moustache, beard, goatee or chin tuft. Skin shadows are not hair.
attempts.rejection_reason: Enlarged original shows a very fine pale gray upper-lip moustache; the returned image has only the normal smooth gray mascot mouth. Restore subtle separate gray upper-lip hairs above the mouth, with clean chin and no thick dark moustache. Retain the actual uniform, medals and fitted collar.
